serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: What’s up?
Shanice: Yo, what good man?
Shanice: We are just preparing for our weekly sermon no one is going to listen to anyway, because currently our average attendance is 0.01 and that’s only because Priestcan put you on the list once.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Give me a break. I put him on the list only the first time he came, before I learned he’s a sinner.
You: …
You: Since you are busy I will just leave.
Shanice: Don’t go! It’s nothing important really. 
Ecclesiasticalot FF: It actually is quite important.
Shanice: Don’t mind the Priestcan. What did you want to talk about?
You: I wanted to ask about that Goku guy you defeated. I just realized I still don’t know what his deal was.
Shanice: Hmmm…{{wi}} To be honest we still don’t know much either.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: And the things we know are classified.
Shanice: Don’t be a dick Priestcan, he helped us. He has the right to know.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Alright. Just keep it a secret, ok?
You: Ok.
Shanice: He wasn’t really talkative about his motive, but after all was settled we did some digging. 
Shanice: We found out that after infecting every Priestbot he wanted to bring them all in one place and merge them together.
Shanice: It’s still a mystery who helped him, but whoever it was had a lot of connections and resources.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Goku was probably backed up by a nation. Maybe a rogue intelligence agency or a secret cabal.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: At first I thought that China is the obvious culprit since they are openly hostile to the Church, but this operation wasn’t their modus operandi.
Shanice: Goku was also the first American pope, but we have no proof that he worked for the CIA. 
Shanice: We don’t know his main objective, who he worked for, nothing.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: We are still working on it. I’m sure when the Vatican finishes their investigation we will know more. 
You: That’s good to hear.
You: At least this Goku guy is no longer a problem. What did you do with him anyway? Did he die or maybe you put him in jail?
Shanice: Oh. About that. He kinda escaped at the last moment. 
You: W-what?!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Don’t worry. He lost all his power over the Swiss Guard. He’s completely powerless now.
You: If you say so… 
You: But someone is looking for him, right?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I’m sure there is a group of investigators searching, but since the whole incident was brushed under the rug, they couldn’t issue an international arrest warrant.
Ecclesiasticalot FF: Chances for his capture are very low.
Shanice: I’m sure his employer put a bullet in his head as soon as he failed and got rid of the body.
You: You have a dark mind Shanice…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I just finished preparations for our sermon. You are welcome to stay. You would raise our attendance.
You: How long will it be?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: About 2 hours.
You: Yeah, sorry. Gotta go. 
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceHappy
Shanice: Yeah, no surprise there!
Shanice: Do you want something from us before you leave?
